prioritization: P1 = enterprise-critical UX, P2 = high impact polish, P3 = quality-of-life

features.title: Local command transcript persistence
features.description: Persist slash-command events locally keyed by gateway/session so history reload does not erase command output. Compact cards with running/complete/error states.

features.title: Confirmation UI for write/destructive commands
features.description: Replace --confirm-only flows with luxury ConfirmationSheet previews for channel stop, session abort, config writes, model set, approvals.

features.title: Live gateway capability catalog
features.description: Replace static capability counts with live descriptor snapshot: supported, scoped, healthy, unconfigured, experimental groups.

features.title: Gateway connection loop hardening
features.description: Improve auto-connect robustness: smarter candidate ordering, clearer phase messages, recovery on token/network flaps, debounced reachability.

features.title: Session management commands
features.description: Add /session current, get, restore, abort, compact, messages with confirmation sheets and SessionSelector integration.

features.title: Chat screen Android native elevation
features.description: Create chat.android.tsx with M3 composer, native pairing sheet, token-driven bubbles, FAB-quality density.

features.title: Terminal screen Android native elevation
features.description: Create terminal.android.tsx with inset pane, M3 SegmentedButton mode picker, native command chips.

features.title: Slash command history and fuzzy discovery
features.description: Recent commands, aliases, fuzzy match in composer palette; permission-aware unavailable states in /help.

features.title: Device auth and pairing repair UX
features.description: Show approved scopes/role after pairing, token repair path, /device diagnostics, device identity in Settings.
acceptance: Repair without re-setup token when possible

features.title: Gateway rename, repair, and stale cleanup
features.description: Rename/edit gateways from Home, pairing repair action, delete-active clears state cleanly, manual reachability refresh with checkedAt.

features.title: Channel start/stop/logout with confirmation
features.description: Implement /channel start|stop|logout with human-readable summaries and Discord/Telegram-specific formatting.

features.title: Web NativeTabs graceful fallback
features.description: Add _layout.web.tsx tab fallback so web does not break on NativeTabs; preserve luxury tokens.
acceptance: No jetpack-compose import on web settings

features.title: ESLint and React Compiler cleanup
features.description: Fix set-state-in-effect, Reanimated shared-value immutability, unused imports without changing behavior.
acceptance: npm run lint passes or major warnings resolved
